description: Returns the statuses of a list of signatures. Unless the searchTransactionHistory configuration parameter is included, this method only searches the recent status cache of signatures, which retains statuses for all active slots plus MAX_RECENT_BLOCKHASHES rooted slots.

parameters.name: tx signatures
parameters.description: An array of transaction signatures to confirm encoded as base-58 strings

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: The configuration object with the following fields:

sub_parameters.name: searchTransactionHistory
sub_parameters.description: (default: false) If true, the search includes the entire transaction history. If false, the search only includes recent transactions in the latest confirmed block

result.description: An object with the following fields:

result.context.description: The information about the current state of the program

result.context.apiVersion.description: The version of the Solana RPC API to use

result.context.slot.description: An integer representing the slot for which to retrieve the fee calculator

result.value.description: A JSON object with the following fields:

result.value.confirmationStatus.description: The transaction's cluster confirmation status. It can either be processed, confirmed, or finalized

result.value.confirmations.description: The number of confirmations a transaction has received. If the transaction is finalized (i.e., confirmed at the highest level of commitment), the value will be null

result.value.err.description: Error code if the transaction failed or null if the transaction succeeds

result.value.slot.description: The slot number in which the transaction was confirmed

result.value.status.description: The processing status of the transaction. It returns Ok if the transaction was successful and Err if the transaction failed with TransactionError
